interventions.detail: Installed undeclared runtime deps soundfile (utils/utils.py) and tqdm (tools/python_executor.py); import qwen_agent fails without them
code_interpreter requires Docker (unavailable in sandbox, no CAP_SYS_ADMIN); patched it to fall back to a local Jupyter kernel subprocess (QWEN_AGENT_CODE_INTERPRETER_LOCAL=1)
Installed the code_interpreter Docker image's packages (ipykernel, matplotlib, pandas, seaborn, sympy, openpyxl) into the venv so the kernel init code runs locally
CodeInterpreter.call crashed with TypeError on dict params despite Union[str, dict] signature; made it accept dicts
Installed Ollama via official install script (needs apt zstd), pulled qwen3:1.7b and started ollama serve; README only links to external Qwen2 docs
